hud.title: Smart throttle
hud.gauge: Downloads may use {p}% of their usual speed right now
add.placeholder: Paste or drop a link to download…
add.severalTip: Add many links at once: a list, or a pattern like file_[001-100].zip (Ctrl+Shift+N)
add.videoTip: Download a video: a YouTube (or similar) link, or a stream (.m3u8 / .mpd). Choose the quality first
add.optionsTip: Folder, name, priority, speed limit, checksum, sign-in (Ctrl+N)
bulk.clearTip: Remove finished downloads from this list. The files stay on disk and in the history.
empty.title: No downloads yet
empty.body: Paste a link above, drop one on this window, or press Ctrl+V anywhere. VeloxFetch splits it into parallel chunks, resumes it if anything breaks, and verifies the result.
set.languageHint: Arabic switches the whole window to right-to-left.
queue.emptyBody: Downloads that are running, waiting for a slot, or paused show up here, in the order they will run.
history.emptyBody: Finished downloads are listed here, newest first, with their files one click away.
side.chart: Download speed over the last seconds
side.diskChart: Disk writes over the last seconds
hud.modeTip: {name}: downloads keep about {k}% of the connection, all the time
hud.info: Fast: full speed. Smart: downloads give way by themselves to videos, games, calls and browsing. Manual: the level you pick (Settings > Smart throttle).
add.pasteHint: The clipboard could not be read: press Ctrl+V in the link bar.
add.noLink: The clipboard holds no http or https link.
sort.name: By name
card.fileMissing: The file is no longer on disk
card.waitingNetwork: No internet connection: it continues on its own when the connection is back
card.autoRetryIn: Trying again on its own in {s}
active.title: Active downloads
active.emptyBody: Running and waiting downloads show here, with their live speed, connections and time left.
done.title: Completed
done.clearTip: Removes every finished download from the list; the files stay on disk
done.emptyBody: Finished files show here: open them, find them in their folder, or delete them from the disk.
confirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
confirm.body: The file is deleted from the disk for good. To keep it, remove it from the list only.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.hint: On macOS, use ⌘ instead of Ctrl.
keys.paste: Paste a link anywhere: it goes in the link bar (several links open “Add several”)
keys.esc: Close a dialog, clear a search
keys.drop: You can also drop a link from your browser onto the window.
about.title: About
about.hint: VeloxFetch downloads your files quickly and reliably.
about.body: Downloads are split into parallel parts, resumed after interruptions, and written to a partial file that only becomes your file once it is complete and verified.
upd.title: Updates
upd.hint: New versions of VeloxFetch, checked against the publisher's signature before anything is installed.
upd.elsewhere: Version {v} is available on the release page.
upd.openedHint: Finish the installation in the window that opened.
upd.autoOn: VeloxFetch will check for updates on its own
upd.unsupported: Updates are not offered in this copy. New versions are on the release page.
upd.trust: Every update is signed by the publisher and checked on this computer: the signature, that the version is newer, and the file's exact size and checksum. An update that fails a check is deleted, never installed. Checking sends no personal data.
upd.err.network: Could not reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
upd.err.signature: Update information was found, but its signature is not valid. It was ignored.
upd.err.malformed: The update information could not be used. It was ignored.
upd.err.stale: The update server sent older information than before. It was ignored.
upd.err.corrupt: The downloaded update did not match its checksum and was deleted. Try again.
upd.err.disk: The update could not be saved on this computer.
upd.err.install: The installer could not be started.
deps.title: Required dependencies
deps.hint: VeloxFetch downloads and updates these by itself, so videos from YouTube and similar sites just work.
deps.checksWhat: answers the checks some sites make before showing a video
deps.joinWhat: joins video and sound for HD qualities
deps.failedWhy: Check the internet connection, then press Download again.
deps.system: Install it with your system's package manager
deps.someFailed: Some required dependencies could not be downloaded
deps.trust: They come from official download servers and are checked against their published checksums before they are used. The Download video bar in your browser is on by default; you can turn it off in the VeloxFetch extension's window (its toolbar icon).
smart.title: Smart throttle
smart.hint: Downloads give way while you browse, watch or play, and take the whole connection when the network or the computer is idle. They never stop.
smart.apps: Programs (one per line: the name as in the Task Manager, without .exe, or the program's full path)
smart.discord: Discord and similar apps that stay open all day are not in the list on purpose: add them if you want.
speed.title: Speed
speed.hint: Cap the combined speed of all downloads, or of one kind of file. Each download can also have its own limit (in its details).
speed.byTypeHint: All downloads of a kind share its limit. Values like 500K or 2M (per second).
net.systemHint: Use the proxy of your system settings (the usual choice).
net.manualHint: Use the proxy below (HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5).
net.saved: Network settings saved: they apply to downloads that start or resume from now on
net.title: Network
net.hint: How VeloxFetch reaches the internet: proxy and user agent.
net.noVault: This system has no secure credential store: the password is kept only until VeloxFetch closes.
net.uaHint: How VeloxFetch introduces itself to servers. Leave empty for the default. Downloads from your browser use the browser's.
multi.title: Several networks at once
multi.hint: Use Wi-Fi, a cable and a shared phone together: each download's connections are spread over them, so their speeds add up.
multi.rules: Only for secure (https) links to sites on the internet. Everything else uses your usual connection.
multi.vpn: A VPN carries this computer's traffic: downloads stay on it and are not spread.
multi.proxy: A proxy is set: downloads go through it and are not spread.
multi.one: Only one network is connected now. Connect another one (Wi-Fi, a cable, a phone) and it is used at once.
multi.leaveOut: Untick a network to leave it out (a phone with a data limit, for example).
multi.smartHeld: Off while several networks at once is on: every network runs at full speed.
netcard.title: Networks in use
netcard.badgeTip: Several networks at once: downloads use {n} networks together
store.chosen: New downloads will be saved in the folder you chose
store.reset: Back to the usual download folder
store.sortOn: New downloads are sorted by type
store.title: Downloads folder
store.hint: Where your files are saved, and whether they are sorted into folders by type.
store.how: The folder is chosen in your system's own dialog. Files already downloaded stay where they are; only new downloads use the new folder. System, program and start-up folders are refused.
store.sort: Sort new downloads into folders by type
store.sortHow: Music goes to {audio}, documents to {doc}, programs to {prog}, and so on, inside the download folder. A file you send to a folder of your own, or to a sub-folder, is saved exactly there.
clip.title: Clipboard detection
clip.hint: Get an offer to download a link as soon as you copy it.
clip.watch: Watch the clipboard for download links
clip.privacy: Off by default. When on, VeloxFetch looks at text you copy only to check whether it is made up entirely of links to files (zip, iso, exe, pdf, video, audio...). Anything else, such as passwords or ordinary text, is ignored at once and never stored or logged. Nothing is downloaded until you press Download in the notice that appears.
clip.unavailable: Your system does not let VeloxFetch read the clipboard while another program is in front (some Linux desktops with Wayland do this). Use Several… on the Downloads page to paste links instead.
power.title: When downloads finish
power.hint: Optionally shut down, sleep or hibernate this computer. Off by default.
power.unsupported: This operating system does not support power actions from VeloxFetch.
power.armed: Armed: {action} once every download has finished.
power.notArmed: Not armed. Nothing will happen to this computer.
power.how: It runs once, only after every download has finished (a download you paused yourself counts as unfinished), and starts with a {secs}-second countdown you can cancel. It is forgotten when VeloxFetch closes.
sched.title: Scheduler
sched.hint: Only download between a start and a stop time, for example overnight.
sched.off: The schedule is off: downloads run whenever the queue is running.
sched.how: A stop time earlier than the start time means overnight (22:00 to 07:00). Each day refers to the day the window starts. When the window closes, running downloads are paused and continue the next time it opens.
diag.copied: Report copied: paste it in your message to support. Passwords, cookies and tokens are not in it.
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.hint: Logs and reports stay on this computer: VeloxFetch never sends them anywhere.
diag.detailedHow: Adds what the engine does step by step (connection changes, fallbacks). Turn it on to investigate a problem, then off again. Passwords, cookies, sign-in headers, proxy passwords and the values in links (?token=…) are never written, detailed or not.
diag.files: Also kept in a few small files that replace each other (a few MB at most).
dup.title: Already in your downloads
dup.t.paused: This download is paused in your list
dup.t.failed: An earlier download of this link did not finish
dup.t.doneLikely: This appears to have been downloaded already
dup.t.gone: Downloaded before, but the file is no longer in its folder
dup.t.edited: Downloaded before, but that file has changed since
dup.r.sameFinalLink: This link leads to the same address as one you added before.
dup.r.sameFile: The same file, under another link.
dup.r.sameChecksum: The same checksum: the same contents.
dup.n.changed: The file on the server has changed since: the copy you have may be an older version.
dup.n.unsure: Whether the file on the server changed since is not known.
dup.n.newName: A new copy gets its own name: nothing is replaced.
addd.passNeedsUser: A password needs a user name.
addd.title: Add download
addd.usualFolder: The usual download folder (sorted by type if that is on in Settings)
addd.checksumHow: Use one from a source you trust, not from the download server itself.
addd.referrer: Referrer (the page the link is on)
addd.sealed: Kept with this download only and sealed on disk; never written to logs. Downloads sent from your browser get these automatically.
mdl.mkv: MKV (best picture and sound, any codec)
mdl.title: Download a video
mdl.intro: Stream links (.m3u8, .mpd) and video pages on YouTube, Vimeo and similar sites. Videos protected with DRM (Netflix, Shahid, STC tv…) and live streams cannot be downloaded.
mdl.slow: Reading the page… The first time, VeloxFetch also downloads the required dependencies for video sites (about 300 MB). This happens only once.
mdl.combine: Join video and audio into one file
mdl.noJoin: This needs the required dependencies, which are not ready. Without them the audio is saved as a separate file. Download them in Settings > Required dependencies.
batch.tooBig: That file is too large (at most {kib} KiB).
batch.title: Add several downloads
batch.linksEg:
One link per line
https://example.com/a.zip
https://example.com/b.zip
# lines starting with # are ignored
batch.patternHow: [001-100] counts from 1 to 100 and keeps the leading zeros; [a-e] counts letters. Up to 3 ranges and 1000 links in all, for example https://example.com/img_[1-20].jpg.
batch.empty: The links that will be added are listed here.
batch.truncated: Only the first {n} are listed; the numbers above cover everything.
pend.title: Download from your browser
pend.ask: Do you want to download this file?
pend.otherFolder: Save this file in another folder
pend.backUsual: Go back to the usual folder
pend.private: Sent from a private window: cookies were not shared.
pend.signInWhen: only if it asks for a user name and password
sign.ok: Signed in: the download starts again
sign.title: Sign in to {host}
sign.kept: Kept with this download only, sealed on disk; never shown again or written to logs.
powb.shutdown: Shutting down in {s} s: all downloads have finished.
powb.sleep: Going to sleep in {s} s: all downloads have finished.
powb.hibernate: Hibernating in {s} s: all downloads have finished.
prev.title: Preview
prev.while: Watch it while it downloads: the start and the end are fetched first.
prev.ready: {got} ready from the start ({pct}%). If the picture stops, it waits for the next part to arrive.
prev.cantPlay: This file cannot be played here on this computer. Once it has downloaded, open it in your own player.
qc.pausedHeld: Queue paused · {n} paused by the queue
qc.label: Queue controls
qc.how: More connections help on fast links; small files use fewer automatically. A new connection limit applies to downloads that start or resume afterwards.
dc.copied: Diagnostics copied: passwords, cookies and tokens are not included
dc.sub: Every attempt of this download. Stays on this computer.
err.title: Something went wrong while drawing this window
err.body: Your downloads keep running. Redraw the window to continue.
mj.playingPart: Playing the part downloaded so far. If the picture stops, it waits for the next part.
mj.playingPartSite: Playing the part downloaded so far. The sound is joined to the picture when the download finishes; if the picture stops, it waits for the next part.
md.gone: This video download is no longer in the list.
md.notYet: The video can be watched once its first part is downloaded.
md.noPiecesSite: This site sends the video as a whole, so only the percentage is shown.
note.depsHd: Downloading required dependencies for HD (only the first time)…
note.depsJoin: Downloading required dependencies to join video and sound (only the first time)…
det.sequential: This server doesn't support ranges, so the file downloads over a single connection.
det.noChunks: Chunks appear once the download has started.
e.401: The server asks for a user name and password.
e.407: The proxy asks for a user name and password: set them in Settings > Network.
e.403: The server refused access. The link may have expired: start the download again from the page, or sign in.
e.404: The file is not on the server (the link is broken or has expired).
e.mediaDrm: This video is protected (DRM), so it cannot be downloaded.
e.mediaLive: This is a live stream: it has no end, so it cannot be downloaded.
e.mediaPlaylist: This link is a playlist or a channel. Open one video and try again.
e.mediaSignIn: The site wants you to sign in to see this video.
e.mediaNoVideo: No video that can be downloaded was found on this page.
e.mediaUnsupported: This kind of video stream is not supported.
e.mediaSite: The site would not give this video.
e.mediaInvalid: The video's description from the site is not valid.
e.mediaLimit: This video was refused: it goes over a safety limit.
e.mediaRemux: The video and its sound could not be combined.
e.mediaFile: The video could not be saved on this computer.
e.416: The server could not continue where the download stopped. Retry starts it again.
e.429: The server is limiting downloads right now. Retry in a moment.
e.408: The server took too long to answer. Retry in a moment.
e.5xx: The server had a problem (error {code}). Retry later.
e.diskNumbers: Not enough free space on the disk: this file needs {need}, only {free} is free. Free some space (or choose another folder), then Retry.
e.disk: The disk is full. Free some space, then press Retry: nothing already downloaded is lost.
e.access: VeloxFetch could not write the file: the folder is protected or the file is open in another program. Close it or choose another folder, then Retry.
e.folder: That folder is not one VeloxFetch may write to. Choose the folder again, then Retry.
e.webPage: The site sent a web page instead of the file (usually a sign-in or "file not available" page), so nothing was saved. Download it from your browser with "Send cookies" turned on in the VeloxFetch extension, or check that the file is shared publicly.
e.checksum: The file is not the one expected: its checksum does not match, so it was not kept.
e.sourceChanged: The file changed on the server during the download, so its new parts were not mixed with the saved ones. Retry checks the server again and starts over safely if needed.
e.exists: A file with this name already exists in the folder. Rename or move it, then Retry.
e.incomplete: The server sent less than it announced. Retry continues the download.
e.redirect: The link redirected to an address on this computer or network, which is not allowed.
e.dns: The server's address could not be found. Check the link and your internet connection.
e.timeout: The server stopped answering. Retry continues the download.
e.connection: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection (or proxy), then Retry.
e.proxy: The proxy address is not valid. Check Settings > Network.
hist.clearAsk: Clear all {n} lines? Files stay on disk.
act.qPausedFinish: Queue paused: running downloads will finish
act.cleared: Finished downloads removed from the list: {n} (the files stay on disk)
app.notLink: That is not a link VeloxFetch can download (http or https).
q.how: Higher priority downloads get the next free slot. Change a priority to reorder the queue.
br.barOn: The Download video bar is on
br.barOff: The Download video bar is off
br.title: Browser integration
br.hint: Detect downloads in Chrome, Edge, Brave or Firefox automatically, and send links with a right click.
br.intro: Once the extension is installed in your browser, downloads that start there are detected by VeloxFetch automatically. No more copying and pasting links into VeloxFetch. VeloxFetch sets it up for your default browser the first time it starts; for another browser, press Install extension next to it.
br.confirm: Ask me before a download from the browser starts (shows the file's details with Start / Cancel)
br.bar: Show a Download video bar over videos in the browser (you choose the quality in VeloxFetch)
br.barDelay: The browser picks up a change within a minute, or at once when you open the extension's window.
br.stConnected: VeloxFetch is connected to {browser} and opened it on its extensions page.
br.stConnectedOpenYourself: VeloxFetch is connected to {browser}. Open the browser yourself and go to its extensions page.
br.stFirefox: Click Load Temporary Add-on… and choose manifest.json in the folder below. (Firefox forgets temporary add-ons when it closes.)
br.stDev: Turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked and choose the folder below.
br.stDone: That's it: click the extension's toolbar icon, it should say Connected to VeloxFetch.
br.stStore: VeloxFetch is connected to {browser} and asked it to add the extension from its store.
br.stStoreAccept: In the browser, press Add to Chrome on the page that opened, or Enable extension in the "New extension added" message (it appears the next time the browser starts).
br.hostMissing: The browser helper program was not found next to VeloxFetch, so browsers cannot be connected. Reinstall VeloxFetch.
br.linkDown: The connection to browsers is not available in this window (another VeloxFetch may already be running).
br.secretsOk: Cookies and sign-in details a browser passes on are kept encrypted on this PC, with a key held by the operating system, and are deleted when the download ends.
br.secretsMem: Secure storage is not available on this system, so cookies and sign-in details are kept in memory only: a download that needed them cannot resume after VeloxFetch restarts.
br.footer: Installing registers a small helper program for your user account only; Disconnect removes it. The helper accepts requests from the VeloxFetch extension alone, and VeloxFetch checks every request again before anything is downloaded.
note.noDepsSite: The required dependencies are not ready, so the video was saved as the site sends it (no HD join, no file type change). Download them in Settings > Required dependencies.
note.noDepsJoin: The required dependencies are not ready, so the sound is a separate file. Download them in Settings > Required dependencies to have VeloxFetch combine them.
power.keepAwake: Keep the computer awake while downloading
power.keepAwakeHint: While something downloads, the computer does not go to sleep on its own. A sleep you ask for still happens.
power.keptAwake: Downloading: the computer stays awake until it finishes.
power.keepAwakeUnavailable: This system does not let VeloxFetch keep it awake.
act.keepAwakeOn: The computer stays awake while downloading
act.keepAwakeOff: The computer may sleep while downloading
desk.title: On the desktop
desk.hint: How VeloxFetch keeps working when its window is closed.
desk.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
desk.closeToTrayHint: Downloads go on and the browser can still send new ones. Quit from the tray icon's menu.
desk.noTray: This desktop does not show tray icons, so closing the window quits VeloxFetch.
desk.startAtLogin: Start VeloxFetch when I log in
desk.startAtLoginHint: It starts quietly in the tray, ready for your browser and your scheduled downloads.
desk.startAtLoginNoTray: It starts with its window open (this desktop has no tray).
desk.notify: Notify me when a download finishes or fails
desk.notifyHint: Only while the window is hidden, minimized or behind another window.
act.closeToTrayOn: VeloxFetch will keep running in the tray
act.closeToTrayOff: Closing the window will quit VeloxFetch
act.startAtLoginOn: VeloxFetch will start when you log in
act.startAtLoginOff: VeloxFetch will not start when you log in
notify.inTrayBody: Downloads go on in the tray. To quit, use the tray icon's menu.
thr.fullFree: Full speed — nothing else is using the connection
thr.checking: Checking whether another app needs the connection · {speed}
thr.fastProfile: Fast profile · full speed, never slows down
smart.auto: Automatic: follow what I do on the internet
smart.autoHint: Measures this computer's other traffic and whether you are at the keyboard. Nothing is recorded or sent.
smart.maxHint: The same limit as Speed limits above.
smart.appsTitle: Smart: also slow down while these programs run (games, calls)
smart.graph: Download speed over the last minutes
sq.editHint: Choose when this queue may download. Everything else is optional.
sq.name: Name
sq.nameLong: A queue name has at most 40 characters.
sq.whenHowBetween: Downloads run only inside this window and pause when it ends; they go on the next time it opens.
sq.whenHowStartAt: The queue starts at this time and keeps going until everything in it is done.
sq.idle: Only while the computer is idle
sq.idleHint: Starts after 2 minutes without keyboard or mouse, and pauses soon after you come back.
sq.idleUnknown: This computer does not say when it is idle, so this rule is not applied.
sq.rulesHint: "Busy" counts everything else using the connection, other queues included. When the connection type or idle time cannot be detected, downloads are never held back. Big files move here once their size is known, unless you chose their queue.
sq.deleteHint: Its downloads move to the main queue; nothing is deleted from the disk.
sq.startHint: Start everything in this queue now, whatever its schedule, until it is empty
sq.clearHint: Remove the finished downloads of this queue from the list (the files stay)
sq.forced: Started by hand · runs until everything is done
sq.gate.open: Ready · downloads start as slots free up
sq.gate.notIdle: Waiting until the computer is idle
sq.gate.busy: Paused while the connection is busy
sq.why.givingWay: Waiting while you use the connection
sq.why.notIdle: Waiting until the computer is idle
sq.how: Running first, then what starts next. Higher priority goes first; use the arrows to reorder downloads of the same priority.
sq.emptyBody: Choose this queue in the Add dialog, or move a download here from its ⋯ menu.
sq.atPast: This time has passed: it will start right away.
addd.badStartAt: Pick a date and time to start at.
act.sqDeleted: Queue deleted · its downloads moved to the main queue
intel.title: Download Intelligence
intel.checkTip: Look at the link before downloading it: size, resume, storage and warnings. Nothing is downloaded.
intel.failed: The link could not be checked. You can still download it.
intel.health.problem: Likely to fail as it is
intel.strategy.parallel: Parallel: starts with {n} connections, adjusted while it runs
intel.strategy.stream: Video: choose the quality in the video dialog
intel.storage.low: Fits, little space left after ({free} free)
intel.storage.tooLargeForDrive: This drive cannot hold files of 4 GB or more
intel.storage.cannotVerify: Cannot verify the final requirement ({free} free)
intel.storage.unavailable: The download folder could not be checked
intel.dup.sameFile: the same file under another link
intel.dup.changed: the server now has another version
intel.dup.fileMissing: the file is no longer there
intel.name: File name
intel.name.taken: Another file named {name} is already in this folder (its contents may differ). This one will be saved as {saved}: nothing is replaced.
intel.name.takenNoAlt: Another file named {name} is already in this folder (its contents may differ). This one will get a new name: nothing is replaced.
intel.name.own: Your earlier copy keeps the name {name}. This one will be saved as {saved}.
intel.name.ownNoAlt: Your earlier copy keeps the name {name}. This one will get a new name.
intel.f.insecure: The link uses HTTP: what is downloaded can be read or changed on the way.
intel.f.httpsDowngrade: The secure link redirected to an address that is not secure (HTTP).
intel.f.otherSite: The link redirected to another site: {host}.
intel.f.authRequired: The server asks for a user name and password.
intel.f.sessionRequired: The link leads to a sign-in page: start the download from your browser while signed in.
intel.f.sessionSent: Your browser's session was sent with the check: the link may not work without it.
intel.f.accessRefused: The server refused access (the link may have expired, or a sign-in is needed).
intel.f.serverError: The server answered with an error ({code}).
intel.f.unreachable: The server could not be reached ({code}).
intel.f.slowServer: The server is slow to answer: it may be preparing the file.
intel.f.temporaryLink: This link looks temporary: download it soon, a later resume may need a new link.
intel.f.temporaryLinkUntil: This link looks temporary and expires {time}: download it soon.
intel.f.expiredLink: This link expired {time}: get a new one from the page.
intel.f.webPage: The server sent a web page instead of the file (often a sign-in or error page).
intel.f.noSpace: Not enough free space: the file needs {size}, {free} is free.
intel.f.tooLargeForDrive: The drive of the download folder cannot hold a file of 4 GB or more: choose another folder.
intel.f.lowSpace: Less than a tenth of the free space will be left after this download.
intel.f.storageUnverified: The server does not give the size, so the free space cannot be compared with it.
intel.f.noResume: Resume may not be reliable because the server does not send parts of the file: a stopped download starts again.
intel.f.resumeUnverified: Resume should work, but the server gives no version information: a change of the file could go unnoticed.
intel.f.unknownSize: The server does not give reliable size information.
intel.f.duplicate: Already in your list, or downloaded before: {name}.
intel.f.stream: This is a video: choose its quality in the video dialog.
intel.ev.rangeVerified: Asked for one byte, the server sent one byte: it sends parts of the file.
intel.ev.rangeIgnored: Asked for one byte, the server sent the whole file.
intel.ev.rangeClaimed: The server announces that it sends parts of files.
intel.ev.etag: The server gives a version tag for the file.
intel.ev.lastModified: The server gives the date the file last changed.
intel.ev.noAnswer: The server gave no usable answer ({code}).
doc.cat.dns: The server's address could not be found
doc.cat.connectionFailed: Could not connect to the server
doc.cat.tls: The secure connection could not be set up
doc.cat.sessionExpired: Your sign-in or session has likely expired
doc.cat.notFound: The file is not on the server (HTTP {code})
doc.cat.serverError: The server cannot serve this file (HTTP {code})
doc.cat.redirect: The link redirects in a way that cannot be followed
doc.cat.rangeFailure: Resume is unavailable: the server no longer sends parts of the file
doc.cat.permission: The file cannot be written in this folder
doc.cat.fileExists: A file with this name is in the way
doc.cat.integrity: The downloaded file is not the expected one
doc.cat.incomplete: The server sent less than it announced
doc.cat.persistence: The download's progress could not be saved
doc.cat.webPage: A web page came back instead of the file
doc.cat.proxyInvalid: The proxy settings are not valid
doc.cat.unknown: The cause could not be determined
doc.source.server: The problem is on the server's side, not your connection.
doc.source.network: The problem is the connection between this computer and the server.
doc.source.thisComputer: The problem is on this computer, not the network.
doc.source.link: The problem is the link itself.
doc.source.account: The problem is the sign-in or session.
doc.source.content: The problem is the content that was received.
doc.source.unknown: Where the problem is could not be determined from what was observed.
doc.retry.retryableWithDelay: Retry later: the server needs some time.
doc.retry.waitFor: Retry later: the server asked to wait {s}.
doc.retry.retryAfterUserAction: Retrying fails again until this is fixed.
doc.retry.unknown: It is not certain that retrying helps.

smart.policyHint: Applied when the program starts and lifted when it closes. Your own pauses, limits and queue settings are never changed.
prof.title: Download profiles
prof.hint: Presets for the settings below. Choosing one applies it at once; your own settings are kept and come back with Default.
prof.defaultHint: Your own settings, exactly as you set them.
prof.fastHint: Full speed, always: many connections (used while they bring more speed), no speed limit, and downloads never give way — not to browsing, videos or listed programs.
prof.balancedHint: Full speed while the line is free, gives way while you use the internet (Smart throttle's automatic mode).
prof.lowResourceHint: One download at a time with few connections, for a busy or modest computer.
prof.live: Changes apply at once to running downloads: fewer connections give way without restarting, a lower number of downloads at once applies as running ones finish. Paused downloads stay paused.
prof.yourLimit: Your own limit ({speed}) comes back with Default.
prof.name: Name
prof.keepHint: Leave a setting on “Keep my setting” and the profile does not change it.
prof.note: The “{name}” profile uses {value} while it is active; this is your own setting.
prof.noteLimit: Set by the “{name}” profile while it is active. Your own limit: {yours}.
prof.smartAutoOn: The active download profile turns the automatic mode on (your switches stay as they are).
prof.smartAutoOff: The active download profile (Fast) keeps full speed: Smart throttle is held off until you choose another profile (your switches stay as they are).
prof.smartByProfile: Turned on by the active download profile: choose another profile to change it.
prof.smartFast: Held off by the Fast profile (full speed): choose another profile to use it.
nl.title: Continue with a new link
nl.intro: Paste a fresh link to this file, for example from the page you got it from. The download continues from what is already saved only if the new link is confirmed to give the same file. Otherwise nothing is changed.
nl.checking: New source found. Checking that it is the same file before resuming…
nl.addNew: Download it as a new file
nl.pendingAsk: A stopped download of this file is in your list. This link can continue it from what is already saved, once it is confirmed to be the same file.
nl.pendingUse: Continue the stopped download with this link
nl.t.resumed: Link replaced. Resuming from the saved progress.
nl.t.started: Link replaced. The download is starting.
nl.t.likely: This is likely the same file, but the server does not confirm it.
nl.t.different: This link gives a different file.
nl.t.same: This is the link the download already uses.
nl.t.unreachable: The new link did not work.
nl.t.kept: The saved progress cannot be continued from this link.
nl.r.etagMatch: The server confirms the same version, and the saved parts match.
nl.r.bytesMatch: The saved parts match what this link sends, but the server does not confirm the version. If the file turns out different, the result may be damaged.
nl.r.dateMatch: Same size and date. Nothing was saved yet to compare.
nl.r.nothingToReuse: Nothing was saved yet, so nothing can be damaged.
nl.r.webPage: It opens a web page (perhaps a sign-in page), not the file.
nl.r.etagChanged: The server describes another version of the file.
nl.r.dateChanged: The server says the file has changed since.
nl.r.bytesDiffer: Its contents differ from the parts already saved.
nl.r.sizeUnknown: The server does not give the file's size, so it cannot be compared.
nl.r.sizeOnly: Only the size matches, which does not prove it is the same file.
nl.r.noRanges: This server cannot send only the missing parts.
nl.r.noValidator: This server gives no way to notice if the file changes during the download.
nl.r.sameSource: Asking it again would fail the same way. Get a fresh link from the page, or sign in again in your browser.
nl.r.unreachable: It refused or did not answer. Your saved progress is unchanged.
tl.throttled: The server is limiting connections: using {n} from now on
tl.startingOver: Cannot continue the saved part ({why}): starting over
tl.plannedParallel: New transfer in {n} parts over several connections
tl.renamed: The name was taken meanwhile: saved as {name}
tl.waiting: The server is preparing the file (it answers when it is ready): waiting for it
tl.reverifiedOk: The saved part changed since it was last saved (a crash or an outside change): {n} finished parts checked again, all intact
tl.reverifiedOld: {n} older parts could not be checked.
tl.reverifiedBad: The saved part changed since it was last saved: {bad} of {n} finished parts no longer match their check and are downloaded again ({size})
tl.linkFresh: New link: the download starts from it (nothing was saved yet)
tl.autoRetry: Trying again on its own (try {n} of {total})
tl.linkSame: New link: the same file (confirmed by the server and by the saved bytes). Continuing from {n} bytes
tl.linkLikely: New link: likely the same file (the saved bytes match; chosen by the user). Continuing from {n} bytes
tl.linkRefused: New link not used: {why}. The saved bytes are kept
tl.r.sequential: it was downloaded over one connection
tl.r.ranges: the server no longer sends verified parts
tl.r.size: the file's size changed on the server
tl.r.changed: the file changed on the server, or its version cannot be checked
tl.r.partSize: the saved part has another size than expected
tl.r.bytes: the saved part differs from the file on the server
tl.l.same: it is the link the download already uses
tl.l.unreachable: it did not answer or refused
tl.l.webPage: it gives a web page, not the file
tl.l.size: it gives a file of another size
tl.l.bytes: its bytes differ from the saved ones
tl.l.ranges: it cannot send the missing parts on their own
tl.l.validator: it gives no way to notice a change during the download
tl.l.unproven: nothing proves it is the same file
tl.l.likely: it is likely, not proven, to be the same file
